name: german hang
description: A hang from rings or a bar with the body rotated behind the arms so the shoulders open into deep extension. It prepares the shoulders and biceps for the back lever and skin the cat.
instructions: Hang from rings or a low bar with your feet supported if you are new to it.
Tuck your knees and roll your hips back and up between your arms.
Keep turning until your hips drop behind you and your arms point up and back.
Let your shoulders open gradually and keep your arms straight.
Hold, then tuck again and roll back through to come out.
